question: Identify the synonym of 'Frugal':
solution:
The correct answer is: **Economical**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Frugal"** means being careful about spending money or resources, avoiding waste, and being economical. (मितव्ययी)
 
 
• **Example:** She lived a frugal life, saving money wherever possible and spending only on necessities.
 
 
 
• **"Economical"** refers to using resources, time, or money efficiently and avoiding waste. (आर्थिक रूप से कुशल)
 
 
• **Example:** Buying groceries in bulk can be economical as it saves money in the long run.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'Frugal'** is **'Economical'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Economical**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Wasteful** (अपव्ययी): Spending resources, time, or money in an inefficient or unnecessary manner.
 
 
• **Example:** Leaving the lights on when you're not in the room is wasteful.
 
 
 
• **Extravagant** (आडंबरपूर्ण): Spending excessively or unnecessarily, often for luxury or show.
 
 
• **Example:** He threw an extravagant party to celebrate his promotion.
 
 
 
• **Generous** (उदार): Willing to give or share freely, often beyond what is expected.
 
 
• **Example:** She was generous with her time, helping everyone who needed assistance.
